directive: Preserve the field-tier common-U sharp-envelope kernel and revise only the concrete reviewer findings. Correct Masten--Poirier (2020) everywhere to Quantitative Economics 11(1):41--111, and correct Fang--Santos to DOI 10.1093/restud/rdy049, with the source-check metadata synchronized to the cited published versions. Add a compact auditable worked certificate for the displayed rational witness: report the selected common posterior pair(s), outcome-sign/arc or stationary branch labels, exact feasibility identities and inequalities, and rational isolating intervals for both common-U endpoints and the separate-pair comparison endpoints, so the strict gap is certified rather than asserted. State explicitly that the separate-pair relaxation is an internal outer relaxation and that published marginal-sensitivity procedures are generally non-nested unless an observable-law-dependent translation is proved; do not overclaim a direct numerical dominance over a named non-nested model. Keep the exact envelope, attaining-law construction, degeneracy-complete certification, strict common-pair-versus-separate-pair gap, and tipping-surface claims unchanged unless the certificate itself falsifies one.

Repair the model by making \(\mathcal M\) the closure, in the finite full-data probability simplex, of the strictly positive common-binary-\(U\) laws satisfying the stated odds-ratio bounds. Express its closed boundary by the existing cross-product inequalities, preferably in joint-cell form so null-cell conditional versions are irrelevant. Keep \(\operatorname{OR}\) defined only on \((0,1)^2\): it has no path-independent continuous extension at \((0,0)\) or \((1,1)\). Treat \(\theta\) as an interior chart, and state that \(q\), \(\kappa\), and the endpoint objectives—not OR itself—extend continuously to the compact posterior region \(D_{A,x}\). Then Theorem 1 may retain exact endpoint attainment over the closed class; for the strictly positive interior class claim only \(\inf=L\), \(\sup=R\), and closure of the identified set \([L,R]\), unless an endpoint is separately shown interior. Rewrite the certificate claims in three layers: (i) fixed rational observed summaries and rational budgets: \(\mathsf{CERT}\) returns exact real-algebraic endpoint values, rational isolating intervals, and membership certificates; (ii) arbitrary real observed summaries: assert only existence of a finite semialgebraic stratification over each compact finite-budget box, with formulas over the coefficient field generated by those inputs, and no algorithmically “returned” rational intervals; (iii) rational or real-algebraic observed summaries and box endpoints: define a separate parametric CAD/elimination atlas procedure returning exact quantifier-free sign cells and algebraic strata, with rational isolating intervals only after zero-dimensional specialization. Do not imply that the fixed-budget \(\mathsf{CERT}\) itself outputs an entire symbolic atlas. Add Ciocănea-Teodorescu, Gabriel, and Sjölander (2022, Biometrika) as the closest binary-exposure/binary-outcome comparator: describe its exposure-standardization sensitivity parameters and estimators as distinct from the present single shared binary-\(U\) model with simultaneous treatment-\(U\) and arm-specific outcome-\(U\) odds budgets; say it neither supplies the common-\(U\) envelope/certificate nor automatically sharpens it, and make no nesting or numerical-dominance claim absent a proved observable-law-dependent translation.
